messages:
lee: Quick PSA: the sample curl in /runtime/quickstart is returning 403 for the embedded image URL. Repro: `curl -I https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart` then copy the example `curl https://short.redwood/assets/splash.png` and try fetching it.

riley: ugh, thanks for flagging. short.redwood links can expire after IAM rotations. Is this the one inside the 'Example' codeblock or the inline markdown image?

lee: It's in the 'Example' codeblock (second block). When users copy it it fails in demos.

tara: I can patch. Minimal fix: swap to `/assets/docs/runtime/splash.png` and add a parenthetical note that links are CDN-backed. I'll push a micro PR.

riley: FYI we should avoid presigned shortlinks in examples — they cause flaky copy/paste. Maybe add a lint rule later to detect short.redwood in docs.

tara: good idea, I'll open an issue after the PR. For now PR has two edits: the codeblock swap + an inline comment in prose.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4302 title: "docs: replace ephemeral shortlink w/ local assets path in quickstart" assignee: tara.

lee: Can someone from eng-runtime give a quick review when available? Low-risk but want staging preview check. @riley?

riley: will review in ~20m. If the preview looks good i'll merge. :+1:

docs-bot: PR merged by riley — https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4302 — deployed to staging.

tara: verified staging preview & copy behavior. image renders and curl example returns 200. closing the loop. thanks! :rocket:
